'''Zir'mai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chief Scientist/Legends|chief scientist]] of the [[Inrokini family]] living on [[Copero/Legends|Copero]]. In [[3629 BBY]] the ruling [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]] harbored a fugitive from the [[Eternal Alliance]] named [[Theron Shan]] on Copero and [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] authorized the Alliance to take action against the rogue Syndic and their traitor. Zenta ordered the soldiers of House Inrokini to stop the intruders, but Zir'mai and his men were killed by [[Raina Temple]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chief Scientist Zir'mai appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion as an optional mini-boss during the flashpoint "A Traitor Among the Chiss". Killing him is required for an achievement.
